These four dependency-free runtime modules are reused from the supplied Drive
archive `1LoyFQsv-W8rNd8zbOYm5mOMBPlggAKqS`, extracted at:
`ATO-Core-Klein-Browser-v0.4.0-gate-content_nested/ato_build/src/`.

Modules: automaton.mjs, activation.mjs, address-space.mjs, boolean-ato.mjs.
The integration preserves the donor Automaton/AutomataMesh contracts and executes
fixed partition-analysis implementations. Movement, Evolution, Being, Design,
and Space label five execution partitions, as confirmed by the user. The donor's
configured gate-62 grammar-tool address is retained as a tool address; a file's
identity is its exact SHA-256 and byte/scalar addresses, not an invented gate mapping.
